edits.value: Spec review against NHIA/BLI 3-in-1 batch salary adjustment format (03_Adj3Of1, rev. 114.12.12): field mappings, C/M/O, data types and Report Matrix updated.
Not prescribed by the official format guide (03_Adj3Of1, rev. 114.12.12).
Employees of a unit filing LI(+EI)/OAI, LP and NHI together (the guide applies to 勞(就)保/災保/勞退/健保 and 就保/災保/勞退/健保 units) whose monthly wage total (月薪資總額) or NHI insured amount changes.

Used to notify BLI and NHIA, in one Excel batch, of changes in the LI/EI/OAI insured salary, the LP monthly contribution wage and the NHI insured amount. Wage changes Feb-Jul must be filed by the end of August; Aug-Jan by the end of February; the new amounts apply from the 1st of the month after filing (BLI form 承表S rev. 115.05, instr. 7; NHIA insured-amount guide).

Electronic batch: Excel file uploaded in the NHIA multi-certificate online system (申報批次勞健合一 EXCEL: enrolment, withdrawal, salary adjustment). The official guide (03_Adj3Of1, rev. 114.12.12) defines only column order, values and notes: no start/end positions and no official TXT layout. Salary reductions require supporting documents uploaded in the NHIA system (NHIA East Division flyer). BLI may ask for the last 3 months' payroll records (承表S instr. 8).
Format Explanation for 3-in-1 Batch Salary Adjustment (三合一批次薪資調整格式說明) - NHIA/BLI, revised 2025-12-12 (ROC 114.12.12). Applies to 勞(就)保/災保/勞退/健保 and 就保/災保/勞退/健保 units.

Employee nationality: no field in DD V3.3 -> NEW DD FIELD (proposed): Employee Nationality (+ permanent-resident foreign professional flag for 'L'); TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA. Logic: nationality = TW -> blank; permanent-resident foreign professional (永居外專) -> 'L'; $hr.spouse_nationality = TW and nationality = CN -> '2'; $hr.spouse_nationality = TW and other nationality (incl. Hong Kong/Macau) -> '1'; otherwise 'Y'. Do not use $hr.residential_status (tax residency).
For "Permanent-resident foreign professional" (永居外專), enter "L". "Foreign spouse" ("1") includes Hong Kong/Macau spouses.
Chinese names: nationals at least 2 characters, foreigners at least 1. English names: full name in full-width uppercase letters. Maximum 200 characters.

Enter the monthly wage total after adjustment. BLI classifies it into the LI, OAI and LP band tables after receiving the file.

TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA: new interim pay element = average monthly wage total (月薪資總額) of the 3 months before the adjustment (BLI page 0022929, item 2(1)). Include all pay received for work: base salary, monthly allowances, meal allowance, overtime, attendance/performance/production bonuses. Exclude year-end and assessment bonuses, festival bonuses and profit sharing (NHIA insured-amount guide; LSA Enforcement Rules art. 10). Do not use 58008/58009/6220%: 58009 is additional pay, 6220x are annual/referral bonuses, 58008 covers taxable recurring pay only.
TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA: $hr.nhi_grade::orLabel in force before the change (requires the previous value / history of the HR field). Amount per the NHI insured-amount table.
$hr.nhi_grade::orLabel (current value; same base as WTC 64550). Validation: not lower than the LI/EI/OAI insured salary and the LP monthly contribution wage (BLI form 承表S instr. 6(3)).
$hr.special_identity_code::key when it is 1, 2, 6, 7 or 8; otherwise blank (the batch accepts only these values, guide rev. 114.12.12).

For "Low-income occupational union member", enter "2"; "Awaiting ship onshore", "6"; "Sheltered workers with disabilities", "7". If the pay is below the minimum wage (e.g. part-time), the special identity must be filled.

NOTE (guide rev. 114.12.12, field 11): BLI classifies the monthly wage total into the band tables after receiving the file. BLI checks whether the worker is an LP contributor; if not, no LP contribution or LP wage adjustment is made. If the pay is below the minimum wage (e.g. part-time), fill the special identity (field 14).
The 104.10.05 rule 'leave fields 2, 3 and 11 blank for an NHI-only adjustment' is no longer in the guide: NHI-only adjustments TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA.
